messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: RE: validityMethod(object)
parts:
Dear Antonela,

this is due to missing values in the covariates. Cases with missing covariates are discarded, so when you fit, for instance, the constant model and one with a covariate that has at least one NA, then the two models are fit to two different (sub)sets of the full umf data frame. You have to restrict your data set feeded into the umf to the complete cases. This has been discussed on the list before, please check the archives.

Best regards  --- Marc
